Kept getting better the further on it went. The worldbuilding isn’t great, and I think is intentionally left a little mysterious, but it makes it harder to fully understand the story. The first third was pretty slow but it kept getting faster and faster paced until the end is moving super quick. Went from like a 5 to an 8 throughout the book. Would recommend doing physical not audio.
